title: RitualCore Altar: Important Systems
summary: Read altar blocks, pedestal inputs, stability checks, events, and bridge rituals.

blocks.title: Altar Array
blocks.body: Basic Altar, Rune Circle, Offering Pedestal, Stability Pylon, Moon Dial, Weather Anchor, and Corrupted Altar define the ritual vocabulary.

blocks.title: Execution Gates
blocks.body: Structure validation, safe item checks, pedestal consumption, catalyst consumption, and ritual events keep bad attempts from eating resources.

blocks.title: Bridge Rituals
blocks.body: Relic Stabilization, Curse Cleansing I, Spell Core Awakening, and Rift Crack Reveal depend on optional systems but should fail clearly when a target is absent.

blocks.title: State Check
blocks.body: Use the system note to read the current state, then choose one action that answers it.
